title: [xpu][test] Port 5 distributed tests cases on Intel GPUs
tests: Clause (3): enabling existing distributed tests on another accelerator (XPU), including @skipIfXpu skips added as part of the enablement.
reason: Ports 5 distributed test files to Intel GPUs.
